newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: France to respect Euro bank's independence - Gaddum.
newsitem.headline: France to respect Euro bank's independence - Gaddum.

text.p: Bundesbank Vice President Johann Wilhelm Gaddum said he had no doubt that France would respect the independence of the European Central Bank as anchored in the Maastricht Treaty.
He told Reuters at the World Economic Forum in Davos that there were some people in France who questioned this.
"But what is decisive is what the French political leadership thinks, and here I have no doubt that it backs the compromises found in the Maastricht Treaty," he said.

Earlier Bank of France Governor Jean-Claude Trichet said the French proposal for a stability council to accompany the single currency in 1999 would not threaten the independence of the future European central bank.
